title: Smart Connect - Deutsche Post
meta_description: Smart Connect is THE App for info & interactions all around Deutsche Post DHL.
full_description: Smart Connect is THE mobile app for relevant news, information and interaction all around Deutsche Post and DHL. Employees can stay up-to-date on what is going on in their region and in the company worldwide. Users can customize the app towards their needs via several user groups.GAMECHANGER FOR DEUTSCHE POST DHL GROUP For the first time in Deutsche Post DHL Group’s history, ONE App is connecting all colleagues with each other – a real gamechanger both for teams as also for each colleague individually. The communication and collaboration is simplified thanks to Smart Connect and information and services can be accessed anytime, anywhere.CHAT AND INTERACTIONS The app is interactive: Customers and employees can use the chat functionality and social walls to collaborate with each other and learn more about the company. They can ask questions, share experiences and posts pictures.LOGIN AND LET’S GO To use the internal content and functionalities of Smart Connect, you need to have individual credentials for the login. Each employee receives these individually.
